title: Design, synthesis and anticancer evaluation of naphthalen-1-yloxyacetamide derivatives against MCF-7 cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36152-36164
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06524K, Paper
Open Access

Maha Ali Alghamdi, Mustafa R. Abdulbaqi, Rana Abdullah Alghamdi, Eman Fayad, Dalal Nasser Binjawhar, Hanadi A. Katouah, Abdullah Yahya Abdullah Alzahrani, Amal M. Youssef Moustafa
Herein, a set of naphthalen-1-yloxyacetamide-tethered 2,3-disubstituted acrylamide conjugates was synthesized in a good yield and evaluated for their cytotoxicity against MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
